title: Answer: organisms and brain states, under naturalism, with no selves among them

statements.text: The theory works under naturalistic assumptions and adds no fundamental entity for consciousness or the self. What exist are biological organisms and their brain states, some of them self-models, and in naturalist metaphysics there are no intrinsically normative facts or essences. The self is not among the basic furniture of the world.

sources.quote: Biological organisms exist, but an organism is not a self.
Viewed from the philosophical perspective of a thoroughgoing naturalism, there are no intrinsically normative facts
